A confiança mede o reconhecimento dos ob: Confidence measures object recognition. It does not verify that a photo is authentic, recent or taken at the reported location. No detections does not mean there is no waste.
O limite de detecções foi atingido. Esta: The detection limit was reached. This count may be incomplete.
O modelo reconhece sacolas, garrafas, em: The model recognizes bags, bottles, packaging and other plastics. Heavily overlapping boxes are reduced to one identification, keeping the most confident one. Nearby objects may still be confused; this is an estimate of visible items.
Média aritmética das confianças dos iten: Arithmetic mean of retained item confidence: below 60% → low; 60 to below 80% → intermediate; 80% and above → high. These ranges organize review and do not validate authenticity or environmental severity.

Confira a permissão de câmera no navegad: Check camera permissions in your browser. On mobile, open the site over HTTPS. You can also take a photo with your phone and use “Upload photo”.
A IA confirma se a foto é verdadeira?: Does AI confirm that the photo is authentic?
Não. A confiança indica o reconhecimento: No. Confidence indicates object recognition. It does not prove the authenticity, date or location of the photo. No detections does not mean there is no waste.
Como escolho o nível do local?: How do I choose the site level?
Escolha entre “Sem resíduos”, “Pouco”, “: Choose “No visible waste”, “Low”, “Moderate”, “Very polluted” or “Blocking” based on what you observed. You provide this level; AI counts visible objects and does not determine whether the canal is blocked.
